LESSON: SIDES OF OBJECTS

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 3.1: Sides of objects

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Sides of objects. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different sides of environment 2. What is the difference 10 lessons objects in the environment • Guide learners to compare between this side and this

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SIDES OF OBJECTS
Sides of objects is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Sides of objects problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Sides of objects question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Sides of objects question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Sides of objects set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Sides of objects.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Sides of objects in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify different sides of environment 2. What is the difference 10 lessons objects in the environment • Guide learners to compare between this side and this

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
